video_title: Lamelo Ball Sent Me A Mystery Box

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark reviews the LaMelo Ball LaFrance jersey design
quotes.excerpt: World Cup season just ended. This is tough, this is dope, a lot of colors, lot going on.
quotes.quote: We just threw the jersey on. World Cup season just ended. This is tough, this is dope, a lot of colors, lot going on. On the back, you get the little LF. It is just a jersey, but easy to dress up or dress down and throw a pair of jeans on or you can throw a pair of sweats on.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark praises the comfort and fit of LaMelo Ball's polo
quotes.excerpt: The polo is hell of comfortable, the material is great. You definitely wear this out to dinner.
quotes.quote: The polo is hell of comfortable, the material is great. You definitely wear this out to dinner or something like that. You can rock it with a pair of the jeans he sent. The material is cozy as hell. It made me feel like I am walking around in a blanket and it fit good. That is my biggest thing, being 6'4" with a 7'2" wingspan, it is hard to find clothes that fit me. The fact that these actually come down to my wrists like how the shirt is supposed to fit is cool.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark discusses the style and utility of LaMelo Ball's shorts
quotes.excerpt: I like the three-quarter shorts, you know, this is moving into having longer shorts nowadays.
quotes.quote: I like the three-quarter shorts, you know, this is moving into having longer shorts nowadays. They fit really nice. Not something you work out in, I think this is more of a dress-up thing than a dress-down thing. He gave us a few other things if you want to throw on while you work out you can, but this is definitely more of a, you throw on a white shirt or something with some earrings and go ahead and hit the town.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark reviews the LaMelo Ball mismatch shorts and hoodie
quotes.excerpt: I have seen like Balenciaga and brands do stuff like this. I never seen it on the shorts.
quotes.quote: We just tried the blue john on. I am rocking with this one, the two different shorts. I think it look hell of dope, make your eyes go everywhere and then the double hoodie. You throw this on with some forces, white forces, this is hell of smooth.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark

quotes.quote: That is smooth. Hold on, you can unzip them shits and make them shits some cargos. They go all the way around. So this is versatile. Now this fit go. He figured out that you can unzip these and they turn into cargos. They go all the way around.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark reviews the LaMelo Ball peach hoodie and sweatpants
quotes.excerpt: I like the peach color and it actually fits, you know as an athlete with longer limbs.
quotes.quote: We just put the hoodie and stuff on. Like I said, you know you are hell of cold in Minnesota. So any type of jacket for real is fire. I like the peach color and it actually fits, you know as an athlete with longer limbs it is hard to find something that fits our sizes. So this is hell of cool.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark

quotes.quote: This is my favorite fit right here. We got the little crop, you know, crop look that is in nowadays where you wear your baggy shirt underneath. Got the jacket with the sleeves and the sweats that go down. Make sure your sweats ain't flooded, man. We ain't wearing sweats that go below your socks, man. It is definitely hell of comfy.
